gamefaqs.section: Wii VC Game Save File (North America)

format: Wii data.bin (an SD-card export; header AES-128-CBC with the SD key, header MD5 valid): title 00010001-NAEE "Paper Mario", 1 file: EEP_NMQE 131072 bytes - EEP_NMQE is the N64 cartridge save in console byte order

verified.converted_with: tools/gamefaqs/wiivc-convert.py convert paper-mario.22873.bin OUT: decrypts the data.bin (AES-128-CBC, SD key, per-file IVs) and takes EEP_NMQE (131072 bytes, FlashRAM): first 0x20000 bytes, 32-bit words reversed, at 0x28800

converted_standalone.how: the same bytes as the .srm regions, as standalone Mupen64Plus keeps them: <GoodName (32 chars)>-<MD5 8>.eep/.sra/.fla/.mpk in its save folder

verified.baseline: with no save: four files, all NEW
